title: 군 상용차량의 전기차량 전환에 관한 연구
abstract: 국 문 요 지&#xD; &#xD; &#xD; 저탄소·친환경을 위한 세계적인 합의로 각 국 정부들은 내연기관 차량에 대한 판매금지 계획과 친환경 차량에 대한 장려 혜택을 정부 주도하에 발표하고 있다. 소형·중형·대형 등 모든 차종과 체급에서 굴지의 자동차 제조사들은 앞 다투어 전기 차를 개발하고, 상용화 전략을 경쟁적으로 발표하고 있지만, 아직 우리 군에선 전기 차의 도입이 요원한 실정이다. 실제 배치되어있는 내연기관 차량의 임무수행에 문제가 없으며, 운용 소요대비 배치가 충분히 되었기에 추가 예산을 편성하여 신규 차량을 상용 전기 차료 교체하지 않는 것은 당연한 현상이나, ’25년 연간 신차 판매의 50%, ’30년 80%를 전기를 동력원으로 하는 차량으로 전환하는 현 정부의 정책 기본계획을 고려할 때 현 내연기관 차량의 전기를 동력원으로 하는 차량 전환은 필수적 과제로 생각된다.&#xD; &#xD; 특히, 국가 위기사항을 대비한 행정안전부의 비상대비자원관리법이나, 국방부의 국방동원업무 규정에는 민간인력 및 물자를 징발하도록 명문화 되어있고, 이에 따라 상용 SUV, 트럭, 특장차들에 대해 매 해 현황을 최신화하고 소집통지서를 발부하고 있다. 신차에 대한 소집통지를 우선순위로 하는 상기 법령과, 정부 정책기조, 세계적 추세를 고려할 때 관련 설비 및 정비요원 교육의 인프라 구축과 더불어 군 상용 차량의 전기 차량 전환이 이루어져야 할 시기이다. &#xD; &#xD; 본 논문에선 현재 국군의 상용차 중 가장 많이 보급되어 있고, 자료획득이 용이하며, 군 운영과 밀접하게 연관된 화물차량에 대한 운용현황 및 유지비용을 연등가 비교법을 통해 계산함으로써 군에서 운용중인 내연기관을 동력원으로 하는 차량의 잔여 경제수명 및 재 구매 시기를 확인하고, 경제수명 도래 차량에 대한 전기 차로의 전환 시 예상 절감비용 분석 및 국내·외 동향분석을 통해 군 내 전기 화물차량 운용을 위한 발전적 제안을 도출하였다. &#xD; &#xD; 도출된 제안을 군 상용 차량의 전기 차 전환 시 적용하게 되면 작전지역의 물자 이동시 연료비용을 대폭 절감하며, 단순한 정비 구조는 최초 고장 발생 가능성이 내연 기관 차량에 비해 현저히 적은 한편 고장 시 조치항목이 전문 정비인력의 입고정비·출장 정비 수준에서 실제 운용자가 가능한 부대정비 수준까지 하향됨으로써, 이에 따른 인력과 물자 차액을 접적지역에 보강함으로써 예산절감은 물론 다가오는 인구 절벽에 대비할 수 있을 것으로 생각된다.&#xD; &#xD; ABSTRACT&#xD; &#xD; &#xD; &#xD; &#xD; A study on the replacement of&#xD; Korea military commercial vehicle to electric vehicle&#xD; &#xD; &#xD; &#xD; Kim, Dong Hyeon&#xD; Dept. of Convergence Defense&#xD; Graduate School of&#xD; Hanyang Univerity&#xD; &#xD; &#xD; &#xD; &#xD; As a global agreement for low-carbon and eco-friendly, each country government is announcing a plan to ban sales of internal combustion engine vehicles and incentives for eco-friendly vehicles in all models and weight classes, such as small, medium, and large. Leading car manufacturers in the market are competing to develop electric vehicles and competitively announcing commercialization strategies. However, in our army, the operation of electric vehicles is still a long way off. There are no problems in performing the mission of the internal combustion engine vehicles while deployment of combustion engine vehicle was sufficient for the operational requirements. Therefore there is no reason to replace commercial vehicles with new electric ones. But considering the current government's basic policy plan to convert 50% of annual new car sales in '25 and 80% of new car sales in '30 to vehicles powered by electricity, conversion of vehicles using electricity as a power source for current internal combustion engine vehicles are considered to be an inevitable task.&#xD; &#xD; &#xD; Especially, the Emergency Preparedness Resource Management Act of the Ministry of Public Administration and Mobilization Regulations of the Ministry of National Defense has proposed requisition of civilian manpower and supplies. In this regard, the current status of the convocation notice has been updated every year. When considering the above laws, government policy and global trends of giving priority to the notification of convocation for new cars, it’s time to convert military commercial vehicles to electric vehicles along with the establishment of infrastructure for training related facilities and maintenance personnel.&#xD; &#xD; &#xD; In this paper, the current operational status and maintenance cost of commercial vehicles, especially cargo vehicles, of the ROK army by calculating through the year-equivalence comparison method check the remaining economic life and repurchase time of vehicles powered by internal combustion engines operated by the military. Developmental proposals for the operation of electric freight vehicles in the military were derived through analysis of expected cost savings and domestic and foreign trends in the transition to electric vehicles for vehicles with economic life expectancy.&#xD; &#xD; If the proposal applied to the conversion of military freight vehicles to electric, the fuel expenses in the operation area will have decreased significantly. The simple maintenance structure is significantly less likely to cause a breakdown. Also the measures to be taken in the event of a breakdown are lowered from the car body shop maintenance and on site trip maintenance level of professional maintenance personnel to the level of incidental maintenance that can be operated by actual operators. Accordingly, by reinforcing the difference in manpower and materials in the border area, it is thought that it will be possible to reduce the budget and to prepare for the upcoming population decline.
author: 김동현

title: Auditing procurement contracts for defense material in Spain: In the footsteps of the U.S. model
abstract: In Spain contract auditing has been applied since 1988 to determine the final cost of defense procurement contracts. In this respect, the Spanish Department of Defense takes the US methodology as a reference model, and therefore it may be useful to study the degree of convergence between the two models. The main objective of this paper is to analyze the degree to which the US contract auditing model for the procurement of defense materiel has influenced the system applied in Spain. Accordingly, the comparative method is used to highlight the main features of the contract auditing models used by the Spanish and the US Departments of Defense. The results obtained show that the methodology used by Spain is not an original approach, but that there is only a low degree of convergence with the US model.
author: Aguado-Romero, José;López-Hernández, Antonio M.;Vera-Ríos, Simón;

title: Intelligent Optimization Method and Network Security Analysis for Power System Active Control
abstract:
Abstract

Optimizing the active control of the power system and improving the stability of the system in the face of cyber-attacks are necessary to secure the power supply and achieve energy saving and emission reduction. The article proposes an improved granular computing method applied to power system active control, which includes chaotic initialization, dynamic parameter adjustment, and a fast search strategy. And also provides two strategies for defense against FDIA and DDoS attacks. The minimum cost of the IGrC algorithm in 5, 10 and 30 unit systems are 43115.67$, 1017569.51$ and 10170321$, and it has good convergence and robustness. The F1 value of the vertical and horizontal prediction algorithm used is more than 90% in all environments, and the optimal marginal cost of this paper’s algorithm is 44.8357 regardless of whether or not it is facing DDoS attacks. Therefore, the active control optimization method and attack defense strategy proposed in this paper have practical application effects.
author: Ding, Chaojie;Li, Lanqing;Zhou, Nan;Gu, Dongjian;

title: Study on Multi-UAV Cooperative Path Planning for Complex Patrol Tasks in Large Cities
abstract: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) are increasingly utilized for urban patrol and defense owing to their low cost, high mobility, and rapid deployment. This paper proposes a multi-UAV mission planning model that takes into account mission execution rates, flight energy consumption costs, and impact costs. A kinematics and dynamics model of a quadcopter UAV is established, and the UAV’s flight state is analyzed. Due to the difficulties in addressing 3D UAV kinematic constraints and poor uniformity using traditional optimization algorithms, a lightning search algorithm (LSA) based on multi-layer nesting and random walk strategies (MNRW-LSA) is proposed. The convergence performance of the MNRW-LSA algorithm is demonstrated by comparing it with several other algorithms, such as the Golden Jackal Optimization (GJO), Hunter-Prey Optimization (HPO), Pelican Optimization Algorithm (POA), Reptile Search Algorithm (RSA), and the Golden Eagle Optimization (GEO) using optimization test functions, Friedman and Nemenyi tests. Additionally, a greedy strategy is added to the Rapidly-Exploring Random Tree (RRT) algorithm to initialize the trajectories for simulation experiments using a 3D city model. The results indicate that the proposed algorithm can enhance global convergence and robustness, shorten convergence time, improve UAV execution coverage, and reduce energy consumption. Compared with other algorithms, such as Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Simulated Annealing (SA), and LSA, the proposed method has greater advantages in addressing multi-UAV trajectory planning problems.
author: Xiang, Hongyu;Han, Yuhang;Pan, Nan;Zhang, Miaohan;Wang, Zhenwei;

title: Rendezvous Missions to Systems of Small Solar System Bodies Using the Suboptimal SDRE Control Approach
abstract: In this work, we analyze the suitability of the State-Dependent Riccati Equation (SDRE) suboptimal nonlinear control formulation for the implementation of body-fixed hovering of a spacecraft in the highly nonlinear environment engendered by the faint force fields around single- and multi-body Near-Earth Objects (NEOs), a class of Small Solar System Bodies with high relevance either in scientific, economic, or planetary defense-related aspects. Our results, addressing the hovering of a spacecraft around relative equilibrium points on the effective potential of the Near-Earth Asteroid (16) Psyche and of the much smaller main body (called Alpha) of the triple NEA system (153591) 2001SN263, show that the known effectiveness offered by the flexibility engendered by state-dependent factorization of nonlinear models is also effective when applied in these faint and highly nonlinear force fields. In fact, this work is a qualitative evaluation of the suitability of using SDRE in the highly disturbed environment around Small Solar System Bodies, which has never been undertaken before. We intend to prove that this method is adequate. For real missions, it is necessary to make deeper studies. In particular, our results show the flexibility granted by the SDRE approach in the trade off between maneuvering time against fuel consumption, a central aspect in such space missions. For instance, our simulations showed control effort and time of convergence for two controlled trajectories around (16) Psyche ranging from a half-time convergence with ∼20 times lower cost. Analogously, for the much smaller bodies in the (153591) 2001SN263 triple system, we got two trajectories in which one of them may converge ∼10 times faster but with up to ∼100 times higher cost.
author: Cereja, Edson;Balthazar, JoséManoel;Tusset, Angelo Marcelo;Razoumny, Vladimir;Prado, Antonio Fernando Bertachini de Almeida;

title: Security Challenge and Defense in VoIP Infrastructures
abstract: Voice over Internet protocol (VoIP) has become a popular alternative to traditional public-switched telephone network (PSTN) networks that provides advantages of low cost and flexible advanced ldquodigitalrdquo features. The flexibility of the VoIP system and the convergence of voice and data networks brings with it additional security risks. These are in addition to the common security concerns faced by the underlying IP data network facilities that a VoIP system relies on. The result being that the VoIP network further complicates the security assurance mission faced by enterprises employing this technology. It is time to document various security issues that a VoIP infrastructure may face and analyze the challenges and solutions that may guide future research and development efforts. In this paper, we examine and investigate the concerns and requirements of VoIP security. After a thorough review of security issues and defense mechanisms, we focus on attacks and countermeasures unique to VoIP systems that are essential for current and future VoIP implantations. Then, we analyze two popular industry best practices for securing VoIP networks and conclude this paper with further discussion on future research directions. This paper aims to direct future research efforts and to offer helpful guidelines for practitioners.
author: Butcher, D.;Xiangyang Li;Jinhua Guo;

title: A Hybrid Optimization from Two Virtual Physical Force Algorithms for Dynamic Node Deployment in WSN Applications
abstract: With the rapid development of unmanned aerial vehicle in space exploration and national defense, large-scale wireless sensor network (WSN) became an important and effective technology. It may require highly accurate locating for the nodes in some real applications. The dynamic node topology control of a large-scale WSN in an unmanned region becomes a hot research topic recently, which helps improve the system connectivity and coverage. In this paper, a hybrid optimization based on two different virtual force algorithms inspired by the interactions among physical sensor nodes is proposed to address the self-consistent node deployment in a large-scale WSN. At the early stage, the deployment algorithm was to deploy the sensor nodes by leveraging the particle motions in dusty plasma to achieve the hexagonal topology of the so-called “Yukawa crystal”. After that, another virtual exchange force model was combined to present a hybrid optimization, which could yield perfect hexagonal topology, better network uniformity, higher coverage rate, and faster convergence speed. The influence of node position, velocity, and acceleration during the node deployment stage on the final network topology are carefully discussed for this scheme. It can aid engineers to control the network topology for a large number of wireless sensors with affordable system cost by choosing suitable parameters based on physical environments or application scenarios in the near future.
author: Li, Qiang;Yi, Qiang;Tang, Rongxin;Qian, Xin;Yuan, Kai;Liu, Shiyun;

title: Improved GASA Algorithm for Mutation Strategy UAV Path Planning
abstract: Track planning is of great significance to the successful defense of the UAV and the completion of operational tasks. Genetic algorithm is a bionic global optimization algorithm that simulates the biological evolution process. It can be used for drone track planning. However, it converges at the late stage of the drone track planning process, and it easily falls into a local optimum. Therefore, a genetic algorithm is proposed. Improved drone track planning method. In the track planning process, a differential evolution mutation strategy was introduced in the genetic algorithm to increase the diversity of the algorithm mutations, and the genetic algorithm was combined with the simulated annealing algorithm. Simulation experiments show that the improved algorithm can get rid of the local optimum, speed up the convergence speed, suppress the prematureness of the algorithm and improve the planning efficiency, and successfully plan a path with the best overall cost.
author: Cheng, Zexin;Li, Dongsheng;

title: 국방IT융합 추진방법론 및 사례 연구
abstract: Information technology convergence has been recognized one of the key drivers in the industry perspective. Korea government established IT convergence policy in 2008 and has been implementing it to the core industry such as automotive, shipbuilding and defense industries. This research analyzes various IT convergence issues based on an operation of defense IT convergence center, one of the industry IT convergence centers. Defense IT convergence issues are as follows : the methods for introducing rapid changing IT to military area, rapid deployment procedures of verified commercial technologies and products, regulations for using of domestic software promotion and so on. We define the concept of defense IT convergence and propose the framework and processes for applying IT to our defense sector as one of industries. Also, we establish various business models in the military perspective using defense IT convergence framework. In this paper, we focus the development of defense IT convergence through the alignment of national IT convergence policy and propose various business models established through operating a defense IT convergence center.
author: 심승배;정호상;유천수;정봉주;

title: 국방IT융합기술의 발전전략에 관한 연구
abstract: 국방IT융합이란 네트워크중심전(Network Centric Warfare) 개념을 실현하기 위해 새로운 IT 융합기술을 개발하여 실제 전력화하는 것이다. 국방부는 창조경제 시대적 사명인 국방IT융합발전을 위해 국방기술품질원의 국방IT융합 센터를 전담기관으로 지정하였고 융합센터를 중심으로 국방IT융합 과제 발굴을 위한 산 학 연구기관과 군 소요조사, 사전 기술기획 활동하며 국방 도메인 전문가로 구성된 과제기획팀 운영과 선진 기획방법 적용 등을 통해 민간IT 신기술의 적기 도입을 중점적으로 추진하고 있다. 이에 따라 국방IT융합 발전을 위해 국가IT융합 정책 추진과 국방IT융합기술 현상을 이론적으로 고찰하고 종합적으로 분석한 뒤 효과적으로 활용할 수 있는 발전전략이 절실히 요구된다. 본 논문은 국방IT융합발전을 위해 식별된 IT융합 과제를 단계화 추진하고 신설된 국방IT융합센터의 효율성을 제고하며 국방개혁과 연계된 IT융합인재 육성방안을 제시함으로써 스마트 국방을 조기에 달성하고 패러다임의 신속한 전환과 창조경제 구현에도 크게 기여할 것이다.
author: 구한림;김성민;이우섭;

title: 국방 IT융합 비즈니스 모델 사례와 성과 분석
abstract: Information technology (IT) convergence have been recognized one of the key drivers in the industry perspective. Especially, IT convergence have been one of the most important innovative way for defense sector. Korea government established IT convergence policy in 2008 and have been applying it to the core industry such as automotive, shipbuilding and defense industries. Recently, the creative vitamin project has been launched. Vitamin 'D' means the way to create the value of defense industry. This research analyzes and evaluates various IT convergence business models based on an operation of defense IT convergence center from 2011 to 2014, which is the industry IT convergence centers. Defense IT convergence business models can be classified into four types of mission area as follows : weapon acquisition and management, military intelligence, military power construction, and resources management. We define the concept of defense IT convergence and describe the framework and processes for applying IT to the defense sector. We analyzes and evaluates various business models designed through defense IT convergence framework and processes.
author: 심승배;유천수;홍수민;

title: IT 융합기술 기반 국방정보 기술동향 및 발전전략
abstract: 국방과학기술은 중장기 기획문서체계에 의해 체계적인 기술기획이 수립되고 있다. 또한 합동참모본부의 전략문서와 연계하여 국방과학기술의 중장기 전략을 수립한다. 무기체계는 지휘통제, 감시정찰 및 정밀타격체계로 구성되고, 핵심기술은 정보통신, 센서, 플랫폼 등 8대 기술 분야로 구성된다. 국방정보 기술은 국방에 관한 정보를 생산, 유통 또는 활용하여 국방 분야의 제반 활동을 가능하게 하거나, 미래 전장운용 개념 구현 및 국방경영 효율화를 지원하여 국방비전 및 국방개혁을 달성하는 핵심 기능 역할을 수행하는 것을 의미한다. 국방정보 기술 개발의 목적은 한반도 전 구역에서 실시간 및 근실시간으로 요구 수준 및 정확성을 확보하기 위해 전장가시화, 네트워크화된 지휘통제, 효과 중심 정밀타격, 전쟁지속을 위한 인사, 군수, 동원 등 통합지원체계를 구축하여 미래전 양상과 국방정보화의 특성을 고려한 실시간 정보공유 및 관리 가능한 정보화 환경을 구축하는 데 있다. 본고는 국방정보 기술 체계 및 요소기술에 대한 특성과 적용기술 및 발전 방향을 살펴본다.
author: 계중읍;이재홍;임동선;

title: 국방 IT 융합 실험 프로그램의 위험관리 요인에 대한 탐색적 연구
abstract: 4차 산업혁명의 영향으로 국방에서는 IT 기술을 다양한 무기 및 비무기체계에 융합하여 혁신을 추구하고 있고 융합의 대상과 규모가 확대되고 있다. 위험을 식별하고 관리하는 것은 프로젝트 관리의 관점에서 성과를 달성하기 위해 프로젝트를 성공적으로 종료하는 데 중요한 요소이다. 본 연구는 국방 IT 융합실험 프로그램의 위험관리 요소를 파악하고 체계적으로 관리하기 위해 핵심전문가들과 면담를 통한 연구이다. 국방 IT 융합실험 프로그램의 위험관리 요소는 거버넌스 위험요소, 내부 위험요소 및 외부 위험요소로 분류되며 거버넌스 위험요소는 내부 위험 요소에 영향을 미치는 것으로 식별되었다. 본 연구는 국방 IT 융합실험 프로그램 수행에 있어 위험요인의 영향을 분석하기 위한 향후 연구방향을 제시한다.
author: 정현식;김의정;김홍철;이남용;

title: 탄소배출권 거래제도에 관한 법적 연구
abstract: Concerning global warming countermeasures, there are concerns about the achievement of Korea’s environment-related target indicators set by the Kyoto Protocol. However, companies that have already taken measures to save energy are facing a difficult situation to further reduce their own carbon dioxide emissions. A system called “emission trading,” in which these companies, etc. can obtain emission permits through transactions with others and use them to achieve their own goals, is attracting considerable attention not only in industry but also academically. This study outlines the basic structure and characteristics of emission trading and introduces the specific emission trading system and its trends. In addition, various issues to expand the dissemination of emission trading are summarized.&#xD; Recently, in various situations of economic and social activities, the number of cases asking for responses to the ‘global warming problem’ has been steadily increasing. In particular, as the “Emissions Trading” of greenhouse gas emissions started according to the Kyoto Protocol, the creation of an emission trading market is being discussed all over the world. In Korea, discussions on the introduction of emission trading aiming to reduce emissions by the same structure are ongoing. In the field of agriculture, forestry and fisheries, various warming measures such as promotion of the introduction of energy-saving devices are in progress, but participation in the emission trading market is expected in the future. Currently, the domestic integrated market for emissions trading is being tested, and participation from primary industries such as agriculture can be seen.&#xD; If emission trading is expanded in earnest in the future, what kind of response can the agriculture, forestry and fisheries sector take to contribute to global warming and participate in the market? We would like to clarify the task from the contents of the response.&#xD; Above all, this study considers emission trading as a countermeasure against climate change. Emissions trading, which started as a measure against global warming, has attracted global attention. As is well known, the starting point is that although emission trading was recognized as a flexible measure for greenhouse gas reduction in the Kyoto Protocol, the background was that the effectiveness of emission trading was revealed as a countermeasure against acid rain in the United States. The EU has already been operating the greenhouse gas emission trading market in the EU since 2005, and each state in the United States, Canada, Australia, and Tokyo has also installed regulations (caps) in order to efficiently achieve the regulations. (Emissions Trading) is being planned or implemented. However, looking at recent discussions, it seems that trade is paying attention to how easily we can trade emission permits.&#xD; The emissions transaction is not a direct transaction in the sense of how effective it will be as an environmental measure. This study outlines the theoretical background and implementation process of emission trading, and discusses the basic direction of emission trading as a measure to reduce greenhouse gas emissions.&#xD; As a global warming measure, greenhouse gas emission rights agreements are attracting attention. In the EU, the emission trading market (EU-ETS) started in 2005, and even in the United States, which has departed from the Kyoto Protocol, at the state level, a total of 30 countries including the Northeastern entire State Federation, the Western entire State Federation, and the Midwestern Union have already been established. More than one stock is planning to trade emission permits.&#xD; At the federal level, bills to introduce an emission trading system have also been introduced to Congress. New Zealand has already started trading emission permits for six greenhouse gases defined in the Kyoto Protocol in 2008, and Australia, which ratified the Kyoto Protocol in December 2007, also said that it would introduce an emission trading system in 2010 in its long-term warming plan. announced. In Japan too, Tokyo Metropolitan Government has implemented climate change measures including emission trading and legal obligations since 2010 at the level of regional governments ahead of national policies.&#xD; At the national level, the Fukuda Vision announced in June 2008, on the premise of “halving the world’s CO2 emissions by 2050,” aims to reduce Japan by 60-80% from the level at that time. In addition, it included the content that the country would start trading emission permits experimentally from the fall of 2008.&#xD; Conventional environmental measures have been centered on measures that directly regulate the emission or concentration of pollutants called command &amp; control with respect to the emission source. Why is it that “trading the right to emit” rather than such direct regulation is attracting attention as a global warming measure?&#xD; In fact, as long as you read articles on greenhouse gas emission trading, etc., participating in emission trading or trading emission permits automatically reduces emissions for some reason, giving the impression of contributing to global warming countermeasures. On the other hand, when looking at the relationship between financial companies and financial institutions with their emission rights business, they seem to be evaluating new financial business and emission rights trading rather than their effectiveness as a global warming measure.&#xD; On the other hand, seeing this movement, some researchers criticize the trend of ‘using even the air as a tool for business’. However, the idea of tr ading emissions of environmental loads such as CO2 was not originally born in the financial market, but started as a part of environmental regulation policy. Then, why is the emission trading in the spotlight as an important environmental measure now? Do current and planned emissions trading really have the effect of reducing greenhouse gas emissions? In this study, we return to the origin of the emission trading and examine the significance of the emission trading as an environmental measure.&#xD; First, there is the problem of external diseconomy. In economics, environmental problems (in the past, pollution problems) have been identified as externalities of the economy. Generally, economics argues for a perfectly competitive market. In a perfectly competitive market, it is premised that all information (costs) on the supply side of a good is included in the supply curve, and that information on the demand side (people’s benefit) is reflected in the demand curve. Therefore, it has been considered that optimal resource allocation and maximization of people’s benefits (satisfaction) are achieved in a situation where supply and demand, where the two curves intersect, reach an equilibrium point. The supply curve is also called the marginal cost curve. It represents all the costs required to produce one additional unit of a good, which increases as the supply increases. That is, it is regarded as a curve that gradually rises.&#xD; On the other hand, the demand curve, also called the marginal utility curve, is a curve that shows the satisfaction (utility) of acquiring an additional unit of the good. becomes a curve. The point of intersection X between the S-S line and the D-D line becomes the balance point. The quantity of goods supplied is Q☆The price at that time is P☆, which is the optimal quantity and price. However, in real markets, the supply curve cannot be said to reflect all costs.&#xD; In general, costs such as raw materials and labor directly related to production, that is, costs directly identified by producers, are included in the supply curve. Since they are not reflected in market prices, they are not included in the costs reflected in the supply curve. As such, costs that are originally incurred but not reflected in the market mechanism are called external diseconomies. Therefore, the supply curve presented in reality becomes a supply curve (S’-S’) that does not reflect all of the original cost. As a result, the intersection of the demand and supply curves is X’, and the output is Q’ more than the original optimal quantity Q☆, and the price is P’ cheaper than P☆.&#xD; If the output is Q’, the optimal price including external diseconomy should be P’ on the S-S curve, but in reality it is traded at P’, which is considerably cheaper than that. In this way, even through the market mechanism, optimal production and price cannot be achieved because the demand and supply curves do not contain all the necessary information is called ‘market failure.’ Next, you need to understand the process for determining the optimal amount of pollution reduction. Pollution and environmental issues are representative examples of this ‘market failure.’ Pollution problems such as air pollution and water pollution incidental to production are thought to occur because pollution costs are not counted as production costs. On the coordinates, the horizontal axis shows the amount of external and uneconomic pollution reduction, and the vertical axis shows the marginal cost for reduction and the social marginal benefit brought about by the reduction of the amount of pollution.&#xD; The marginal cost of emission reduction (the cost to reduce the amount of pollution by one additional unit) increases as the amount of reduction increases. This results in a C-C curve on the right shoulder. On the other hand, the marginal social benefit from pollution reduction (benefit obtained by reducing the amount of pollution by one unit additionally) decreases as the amount of pollution decreases, so the curve B-B gradually decreases. The intersection point E between C-C and B-B represents the optimal amount of pollution reduction W and cost=benefit F at that time.&#xD; However, if left to normal economic activities, the pollution reduction market will not be established and pollution will not be reduced to W.&#xD; In order to reduce the amount of pollution to W, it is necessary to artificially establish a pollution reduction market by some compulsory measure (environmental regulation). As environmental regulations using market control, macro-economically, there are environmental taxes and emissions trading, both of which are considered as means to bring about the same result. The environmental tax measures the cost of the environmental load (pollution), that is, external diseconomy, and imposes the amount as a tax to reduce the environmental load to the optimal level (total pollution).&#xD; Conversely, in the case of emission permit trading, if the total amount of pollution allowed to be emitted or the amount of pollution reduction required is set in advance, the reduction cost is naturally determined at the optimal level. Due to the difference in whether the price is set by regulation, the price is not fixed in the final conclusion. If this is expressed on the coordinate axis, in the case of an environmental tax, F is collected from the polluter (producer) as an environmental tax.&#xD; If polluters reduce the amount of pollution from 0 to W, they can reduce the amount of pollution up to W because the cost of saving is lower than paying F as a tax. Emission trading must reduce the amount of pollution up to W to the producer.&#xD; In either case, the theoretical equilibrium point E is achieved, so the final effect is the same. However, in reality, whether to regulate price or quantity (emission rights trading) has different political and social meanings. First of all, in the case of taxes, it is politically difficult to make them invalid because there is political resistance.&#xD; Next, the marginal cost of pollution reduction = the amount of F, which is the marginal benefit, must be accurately measured. However, since it is difficult for the policy authorities to obtain information on the cost of the private enterprise, the optimal amount as an external diseconomic cost is used as a tax. It is considered difficult to determine. In contrast, in the case of emission trading, the policy authority only needs to set the optimal amount of pollution reduction. This is similar to the conventional environmental regulation, that is, the amount of pollution or the concentration of pollution is determined by regulation, so it is easy to implement. In particular, in the case of the global warming problem, it is easy to reach a social consensus on the amount of reduction because the amount of reduction to be targeted is presented based on scientific evidence in the IPCC report.&#xD; Let’s compare emissions trading and direct regulation here. Where is the difference between the emission permit trading that sets the amount of emission reduction and the conventional environmental regulation that simply regulates the amount of pollution reduction? In the case of conventional environmental regulations, uniform regulations are imposed on all producers. Since the cost of reductions for producers varies, it will be more expensive to regulate the amount of reductions uniformly. Let us explain with a concrete example below. For example, suppose that the cost of reducing the amount of pollution by 100 by company A is 100, and the cost of company B is 60. Here, regulations were put in place to reduce pollution by 50 units for both companies. The sum of the cost of saving 100 units by 50 units on each side is 50 units +30 units sum of 80. If the emission permit transaction is accepted here, if B reduces A’s stake by 50 units or reduces A’s share by 100 units, the total cost will be 60, and it will end with a smaller amount than if each of A’s shares were reduced by 50 units. And if B sells 50 units of emissions to A at 40, then A has reduced its emissions at a price lower than its own cost of 50, and the net cost of B’s em ission reductions is also to obtain the proceeds from the sale of the emissions. At 60-40, it becomes 20, so it ends up being cheaper than 30 at the cost of 500,000 cuts from the company. In addition, if Company B further reduces the reduction cost through various inventions, there is an incentive to reduce more and sell the amount of emissions in the market to obtain a sale profit, and there is a possibility that the reduction will proceed beyond the regulations.&#xD; For this reason, emission trading began to attract attention as a means of economically achieving environmental regulations. Of course, by adding a market mechanism to simple regulation, the original environmental standard can be achieved at a lower cost than society as a whole, except in cases where the reduction costs of producers are the same, and there are few producers and direct regulation is simple.&#xD; However, it should be noted that, to the last, trading of emission permits is primarily a regulatory measure. And as a means to achieve it, secondary transactions are recognized. Although the emission rights trade currently being discussed is called cap &amp; trade, what is important as an environmental measure is the total amount that is regulated, that is, the cap part, and trading is only a means to the end. In addition, the following four points are pointed out as a condition for a policy task with high effectiveness of cap &amp; trade. In other words, ① the target pollutant is a phenomenon in which damage appears over a wide area, such as warming or ozone layer depletion.&#xD; ② If the cost burden of emission regulation is large, that is, if emission control is possible at low cost, simple regulation is cheaper. ③ It will be possible to accurately monitor the emission of pollutants from specific sources. ④ The expected market transaction will be of a certain size or more.&#xD; As discussed above, let us recapitulate emission trading (Cap &amp; Trade).&#xD; First, the government (regulatory authority) allocates emissions to operators in each year. Businesses must submit emissions equal to their actual emissions at the end of each year. At this time, since the transaction of emissions is recognized between business operators, the business operator whose actual emission is less than the emission amount can sell the difference as emission credits. The emission permit market created based on these regulations includes EU-ETS in the EU, CER by CDM project, and ERU by JI.&#xD; As shown in the current historical data, the transaction volume in 2007 was less than 900 million tons-CO2 by Kyoto credit compared to 2,061 million tons-CO2 for EU-ETS, and the price of EU-ETS is high. Here, even in EU-ETS and Kyoto credit, it is important to note that JI is an emission right between entities with a cap, but CER by CDM project is not. The purpose of the CDM is “to achieve sustainable development in developing countries and at the same time to achieve emission reduction targets in developed countries.” The problem here is that developing countries do not have reduction targets (caps). If so, on what basis do you plan to reduce it? This calculation includes the minimum &amp; credit sales method.&#xD; This is the idea that the difference from the actual emissions after the project is implemented as an emission credit by minimizing the hypothetical emissions generated when the CDM project is not implemented. In other words, it is in the lowest price cap. Therefore, the minimum calculation method needs to be based on the methodology approved by the CDM Board of Directors. CER levels are rigorously screened and monitored and are considered reliable. However, the lowest idea is not to identify countries’ emissions as an absolute value and reduce it from the absolute value, but rather an ambiguous number of reductions from hypothetical emissions that would have increased without the project according to economic growth. Even if the lowest rationale is understood, the basic assumption is that developing countries will increase their emissions. By transacting the hypothetical reduction calculated on such a premise, the effect of reducing global emissions is inevitably limited even if it is added to the reduction targets of developed countries. Therefore, although the significance and effectiveness of the CDM are acknowledged, unless one party (developing country) imposes a cap, it is necessary to increase the CER thus created and consider the emission trading as a response to climate change.&#xD; However, it is not expected that it will easily lead to a large reduction in the global greenhouse gas halving. Above all, it is essential for CDM projects not only to reduce greenhouse gas emissions, but also to contribute to the sustainable development of the society. However, as a result of the CDM project, even if the allowances supplied to the emission trading market had the effect of mitigating the increase in emissions from developing countries, it is unlikely that they will be directly related to the absolute reduction. What is needed is to focus on emission rights through a trading system, such as EU-ETS, in which a cap is placed on all entities that produce emission rights (emissions operators, etc.). In addition, it is the making of a device that broadly produces social reduction incentives by widely trading emission permits, including allowances with social added value like CER.&#xD; Aside from regulated markets such as CDM, there is also a growing market that deals with GHG reductions from private demand. In fact, there are various reduction measures that can be implemented in developed countries without relying on CDM, etc. implemented in developing countries. If solar power generation is introduced into a private house, a CO2 reduction effect can be expected, and if the air conditioner is stopped by increasing the insulation performance of the house, there is a CO2 reduction effect. In addition, if afforestation is carried out properly, the effect of reducing CO2 by fixing carbon is recognized. Independent trading of emission permits, in which a third party authenticates and trades CO2 emissions that have been actually reduced by individuals and small and medium-sized businesses due to the conversion to energy saving and renewable energy, is also taking place around the world. These emission rights are generally called VER (Verified Emissions Rights), and VER is traded in an independent market (OTC market). The VER market is still small compared to regulated markets such as EU-ETS and CER.&#xD; The difference between the minimum emission and the greenhouse gas emission (project emission) after the implementation of the CDM project is the amount of emission reduction by the CDM project (i.e. the amount of credit). As shown in the historical data, 2007 turnover in these regulated markets exceeds 29 million tonnes-CO2, but in OTC markets it is only 65 million tonnes-CO2. However, compared to only 24.6 million tonnes-CO2 in 2006, the growth of this market is also high. A CDM project minimum (scenario and emissions) is a scenario that reasonably represents the greenhouse gas emissions that would have been emitted in the absence of a proposed project.&#xD; Examples of projects targeted by VER include energy efficiency improvement, methane recovery, afforestation, land use, and renewable energy such as solar power. In addition to acknowledging the off-set effect of private-based projects or projects, there are cases where the CO2 reduction project handled by local governments is used as an off-set emission range.&#xD; The use of credit trading by private companies or individuals to voluntarily reduce greenhouse gas emissions, not to fulfill their obligations to achieve goals such as the Kyoto Protocol, is called off-set. A business that supplies the set) is called an off-set provider. Carbon offset companies buy CER or VER with CDM and sell them to companies, groups, or individuals who want to ‘off-set carbon’ by making them on a small scale. For a company or organization that buys off-set, its main buying motive is its social responsibility and advertising. Recent examples include New Year’s cards with off-sets sold for New Year’s greetings, and travel packs with off-sets of CO2 emissions from travel. In addition, as part of the global warming measures in Korea, the policy of carbon offset (off-set) as a measure to broadly give incentives to the public to reduce emissions has come to be discussed. This becomes a system that properly selects an off-set program that can secure reliability, such as the basis for calculating the offset and the establishment of a monitoring system. With reduction incentives, you can expect an effect that actually leads to greenhouse gas reduction.&#xD; How should emissions trading be regulated as a viable GHG reduction measure? This study aims to examine various legal issues regarding the phenomenon of greenhouse gas (mainly CO2) emission rights trading, which is attracting attention as a warming measure, starting with the historical background of the trading of emission rights for environmental pollutants. In the recent debate on emission trading, when announcing the introduction of the emission trading system, they mention emission trading as a last resort for measures against global warming. But is emission trading really such a panacea? As seen here, the idea of em ission trading is that the reduction of the environmental load is more effective by adding a market mechanism to the existing environmental measures (direct quantitative regulatory measures). Its basis lies in cap regulation to the last, as it is called Cap &amp; Trade. In the market, there is an environmental regulation, and trading is permitted only as an auxiliary means to achieve it. However, looking at the recent form of the emission trading market, it seems that there are not a few operators who have been participating in the understanding that it is a simple financial transaction accompanied by an increase in trading volume.&#xD; In addition, although the Fukuda Vision emphasized the early experimental start of the domestic emission trading market, the focus is placed on creating an efficient trading market when looking at the thoughts of the industry and the government. So it seems that the discussion of cap (regulation) is almost forgotten.&#xD; In addition, it is natural that complex calculations, rigorous monitoring, and proper management and storage of the data are necessary to determine the rights arising from the air. This further means that the emission of greenhouse gases, which were emitted by everyone for free, is recognized as a right only for certain groups. In other words, the initial allocation of emissions has the same meaning as the allocation of subsidies, and is likely to cause political controversies. For example, in the EU-ETS, the cap in Phase 1 was loose, and in Phase 2, emission rights trading was considered as a climate change measure, which was somewhat strict. It wasn’t big enough to be. Also, regarding the initial allocation, it is considered economically that any initial allocation does not affect the final conclusion. However, in Stage 1, the initial allocation was an allocation that reflected the past emission performance, so it was an undesirable result that operators who were paying a lot had an advantage. It is also important to scrutinize the legal structure in which the credits were created.&#xD; If a strict cap is placed on the premise of a wide range of participants such as EU-ETS, the actual reduction effect of greenhouse gas will not be small.&#xD; However, if the cap has a loose structure, the reduction effect is small even if it is traded.&#xD; The introduction of various emission trading systems, which are currently being discussed at home and abroad, has a number of issues, such as distribution issues, the basis for calculating greenhouse gas emissions, the creation of registers, and the promotion of coherence for each country’s trading system, in addition to the main purpose of reducing the environmental load. It is easy to focus the discussion on that because it has to be resolved. Among them, the effect of reducing the absolute amount to the absolute amount is quite slim due to the focus on maintaining the competitiveness of companies, such as the discussion that has been reversed, such as ‘loose cap for smooth transaction’ or option 4 of the trading system proposed by the Ministry of Environment. Since some are thrown away, the effect of reducing the environmental load cannot but be questioned.&#xD; On April 25th, the Kansai Economic Association of Japan announced the “Conclusion of Issues on Emissions Trading”. These points are summarized as the results of five research meetings so far by the “Research Group on Carbon Emissions Trading,” which was decided to be established at the “Top Meeting of the Asian Financial System Research Society” held on August 11, last year. In summarizing the points, I summarize basic thoughts on emission trading, which is of increasing interest toward the reduction of greenhouse gases, the cause of global warming. The following is a list of tasks to be focused on in the future and requests from the government.&#xD; Now, for the conclusion of this study, I would like to summarize these contents. The point is:&#xD; 1. Let’s summarize the basic way of thinking.&#xD; The Kyoto mechanism for greenhouse gas emission reduction should be actively utilized. In order to utilize the Kyoto mechanism more effectively, it is necessary to solve and overcome the problems related to the carbon emission trading at an early stage.&#xD; It is necessary to strictly evaluate emissions trading. The ‘Cap &amp; Trade’ type, which sets a compulsory emission range, is opposed as before. However, the company’s voluntary acquisition of credits should be promoted, and the use of market mechanisms for acquiring credits is required.&#xD; Let’s review our activities and emissions trading since 2013. There is a need to establish truly effective international cooperation on countermeasures against global warming. Emission trading is one of the options for advancing global warming countermeasures, and a flexible and wide-ranging policy discussion should proceed.&#xD; 2. What are the reviews and future actions taken in this study?&#xD; It is necessary to realize the smooth management and transaction of emission permits such as CDM using the trust function. The use of trust accounts can be made small to promote energy conservation and environmental measures even for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). In cooperation with research from international cooperation banks, etc., effective and efficient utilization of emission credits for companies is reviewed.&#xD; The local emission trading market should be reorganized based on CSR (Corporate Social Responsibility). It is beneficial to promote measures for the maintenance of the “local emission trading market,” which leads to the reduction of greenhouse gases in a specific region. Investigate pioneering cases in the region and conduct reviews in cooperation with relevant organizations.&#xD; 3. There are three major requests from the government.&#xD; (1) Demand for environmental improvement that promotes emission trading.&#xD; It is also necessary to reorganize relevant government ministries related to carbon emission rights and to clarify practical handling including tax, accounting, and legal aspects.&#xD; (2) It is necessary to examine the establishment of a new system. It is important to establish a structure in which measures that lead to substantial reductions in greenhouse gas emissions are evaluated.&#xD; (3) A review agency under the direct control of the Prime Minister on global environmental issues should be established. In order to review with cross-ministerial leadership based on national discussion, an institution directly under the Prime Minister should be established. Reduction of greenhouse gases, the cause of global warming, has become one of the most important tasks for the international community to deal with. The Kyoto Protocol, adopted in 1997 based on the Framework Treaty on Climate Change, established legally binding commitments for each country for carbon dioxide emissions in developed countries with the goal of reducing greenhouse gases as of 1990. Therefore, in advanced countries, it is an urgent task to improve the domestic system to achieve the reduction target. In particular, since the international emission trading system, which will be implemented from 2008, is considered an effective structure in suppressing reduction costs, governments in Europe and other countries have introduced the domestic emission trading system early to provide domestic companies with information on emission trading. We are trying to acquire various know-how. In Japan, the “Kyoto Protocol Goal Attainment Plan” according to the Global Warming Measures Promotion Act was decided in April 2005 as a necessary measure to reliably achieve the 6% reduction commitment under the Kyoto Protocol.&#xD; In the economic world, the Federation of Economic Organizations formulated the “Environmental Independent Action Plan” in June 1997, steadily improving the performance of reducing greenhouse gas emissions every year and contributing to the achievement of Korea’s goals. The Session has been supporting efforts to curb greenhouse gas emissions in all economic circles. In the midst of this, the ‘Asia Financial System Kansai Research Group Top Meeting’, which is reviewing measures to strengthen the market function in Kansai, established the ‘Research Group on Carbon Emissions Trading’ in August 2006. In this research group, Osaka’s market function, which is based on the world’s first futures exchange ‘Dojima Mishoso’', will continue to play a part in the function of financial markets in Japan and Asia. Based on this perspective, we have been examining the feasibility of the emission trading market in Japan. As a result of the discussion in this study and the survey conducted by the research group ‘Actual Survey on Global Warming Prevention Measures and Emission Permits’ (hereinafter the survey results), and corporate and group hearings, the following ‘Discussions on Emissions Trading’ Organized by ‘clean up’. We will be able to review this as well for reference.&#xD; 1. The basic way of thinking is as follows.&#xD; (1) A summary of the use of the Kyoto mechanism for greenhouse gas emission reduction is as follows. The Kyoto Protocol stipulates the use of the Clean Development Mechanism (CDM), Joint Implementation (JI) and the so-called Kyoto Mechanism of Emission Trading to achieve the target in the first commitment period (2008-2012). In particular, domestic emissions greatly exceed the target, and in Korea, which has little reduction potential, it is indispensable to utilize emission credits that can be obtained from reduction projects in developing countries with large reduction potential. The use of emission permits is an effective way to lower investment costs and more greenhouse gas emissions worldwide, including in Korea, and is expected to create opportunities for Korean companies to spread excellent energy-saving technologies to the world. In addition, the emission permit acquisition project has the effect of facilitating technology transfer to developing countries and foreign investment. However, the following points are pointed out. In other words, the emission reduction project itself is small in so-called credit acquisition, such as the amount of emission allocation and emission reduction transferred to the Kyoto mechanism. In addition, there is a risk that the expected emission credits cannot be obtained after the implementation of the emission reduction project. CDM project review often takes time. In the case of carrying out a project by oneself, specialized knowledge is required in discovering an agenda and writing a project design document (PDD). In addition, it is difficult to respond to small-scale projects handled mainly by small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). In order for the Kyoto mechanism to be further utilized, it is necessary to urgently realize the resolution and overcoming of these problems.&#xD; (2) Summarize the evaluation of emission trading. So far, the emission trading market has been steadily introduced and maintained in the US and Europe. In particular, in the ‘Cap &amp; Trade’ type of emission trading, represented by EU-ETS, the total amount of greenhouse gas emissions and the distribution method to individual entities are determined, and each entity transfers part of the emission range to each other. Acquisition is acknowledged. In this case, it is difficult to secure equity because it is extremely economically controllable to assume that forced emission is set. Therefore, the creation of a ‘cap &amp; trade’ type of emission permit market is unacceptable as it has been in the past as a member of the industry. However, it is noted that Korean companies are also actively moving to acquire emission permits such as CDM specified in the Kyoto Protocol in order to achieve the goals set forth in the Environmental Independent Action Plan by the companies affiliated with the Japan Lightweight Training Institute.&#xD; The background of this movement is to achieve an independent goal while the seriousness of the global warming problem is widely recognized at home and abroad. However, it is pointed out that in the relationship with many domestic and foreign stakeholders surrounding each company, achieving the goal by acquiring emission permits is an important management task. According to the survey results, less than half of the companies (43.7%) were interested in trading emission permits, but by the number of employees, companies with more than 1,000 employees showed high interest (62.8%). In addition, in the manufacturing industry, companies with more than 300 employees are interested in the majority by industry. Emission permit trading should strive to voluntarily acquire emission permits based on the interest of these companies, and it is required to utilize a market mechanism for acquiring emission permits that can realize risk management at reasonable costs.&#xD; (3) Activities after 2013 and emissions trading are summarized as follows.&#xD; After the first promised period stipulated by the Kyoto Protocol, the trend of international examination and discussion will materialize in the future, but it is necessary to establish a truly effective international framework for countermeasures against global warming. From this point of view, for example, there may be a review of the establishment of a new system that evaluates measures that lead to substantial reductions in greenhouse gas emissions at home and abroad, such as improvement in basic units. At that time, if the current Kyoto mechanism system is to be continued in post-Kyoto in any form, it is required to design a system that can more effectively utilize emissions trading, which is also watching the trend of Korean companies. Therefore, it is necessary to grasp the emission permit trading as a framework after 2013 as one of the options for the progress of global warming measures in the future, and to conduct flexible and broad policy discussions.&#xD; 2. The review in the study and future measures are summarized.&#xD; In this study, the ‘voluntary participation type’ in which companies and organizations participate independently in the transaction type and the ‘participation obligation type’ that imposes penalties in case of non-achievement of the target, and ‘international emission trading,’ it has been classified into ‘domestic emissions trading’ and ‘local emission trading’, and the characteristics of each have been reviewed. At the same time, from April 2005, the Ministry of Environment, centered on the ‘Ministry of Environment’s voluntary participation-type domestic emission trading system, reviewed transactions in Europe, and reviewed and experimental responses to emissions trading by private companies and organizations that have become active in various places. As a result of the review so far, I think that this study should focus on the following two measures that Korea should pay attention to.&#xD; (1) It is necessary to realize the smooth management and transaction of emission permits such as CDM using the trust function. By using a trust account, emission permits can be reduced in a small amount, and as can be seen in the “Environmental Independent Action Plan” in Japan, it is a structure that can respond to a small amount of demand. There is also the possibility of urging small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) to take energy-saving and environmental measures. In order to fully demonstrate the excellent function of emission rights trading using the trust function, it is necessary to reorganize the infrastructure in terms of transfer, sale and management of emission rights. Although financial institutions and auditing firms have been repeatedly researching this point, in the future, in cooperation with these measures, measures for effective and efficient utilization of emission permits should be considered for companies.&#xD; (2) It is also necessary to improve the local emission trading market based on CSR (Corporate Social Responsibility). Compared to large enterprises, it is difficult to introduce energy-saving technologies in small and medium-sized enterprises, and relatively few places are sufficiently implementing environmental measures. For this reason, when technology transactions related to energy saving and warming measures are effectively conducted by utilizing market functions, small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) can reduce the greenhouse effect and achieve reduction in energy costs. Therefore, in the future, I think it is beneficial to promote measures for the improvement of the “local emission trading market” that leads to the reduction of greenhouse gases in a specific region. Specifically, it investigates cases of pioneering initiatives in a specific region, and at the same time cooperates with relevant organizations to promote the introduction of energy-saving devices to companies, establish a monitoring certification system for emission reduction, and provide technology with companies accepting the technology Regarding the establishment of a company’s financial settlement method, etc., it is necessary to conduct a review with a view of the experimental operation.&#xD; 3. It seems that the requests for the government can be summarized into three categories as follows.&#xD; (1) An environment that promotes emission permit trading should be established. As the movement to acquire emission permits utilizing the Kyoto mechanism is becoming more active, it is necessary to consider further enhancement of support measures and environmental improvement in terms of policies. In the results of the survey, ‘reorganization of taxation and financial laws’ was mentioned as a task for the creation of the emission trading market. Currently, since emission credits are not evaluated as a financial product, listing on the stock exchange, for example, is not possible. First, in the Financial Instruments and Trade Act, the Ministry of Finance, etc. should be revised so that the market for financial products related to emission permit trading is possible. In addition, in order to promote the use of the trust function, etc. described above, it is necessary to clearly advance the practical handling including aspects such as taxation, accounting, and legal affairs.&#xD; (2) A review should be made to establish a new system. While public interest in global warming is rising, most companies are focusing on energy conservation and energy efficiency improvement to reduce greenhouse gas emissions.&#xD; Since the oil shock of the 1970s, Korea, which cannot but depend on foreign resources for its natural resources, has made a leap forward in the development and dissemination of energy-saving technology, and is at the highest level of technology in the world. The widespread use of Korea’s technology in developing countries, etc.&#xD; will contribute to global warming prevention and at the same time bring about a new vitality of Korean industry. It is important to establish a structure in which the performance of measures that can lead to a substantial reduction in greenhouse gas emissions in Korea is evaluated in the future. If the structure of the current Kyoto mechanism continues in any form in this new system, emission trading may be linked and effectively utilized. In addition, in the establishment of such a new system, it is necessary to review the achievements of the above-mentioned “regional emission trading market” in the Kansai region to reflect the results. In addition, in order to suppress the emission of greenhouse gases in the livelihood and transportation sector, where the emission of greenhouse gases is rapidly increasing, it is necessary to further raise the interest of many people and develop a new system that can link the interest to concrete actions.&#xD; (3) It was proposed to establish a review organization directly under the Prime Minister on global environmental issues. The ‘21st Century Environmental Entry Strategy’, which is scheduled to be formulated this year, specifies the direction of environmental policy to be addressed at home and abroad, and provides guidelines for contributing as a country to the creation of a global policy framework in the future.&#xD; Also, at the 2008 summit of major countries held in Japan, it was predicted that the outcome of the ‘dialogue on climate change, clean energy and sustainable development’ based on the ‘Gleneagles Action Plan’ agreed at the 2005 summit would be achieved.&#xD; In addition, Korea has grown as an environmentally advanced country while thoroughly examining the domestic and international situation regarding the framework after 2013.&#xD; Thus, it is expected that bold policy proposals will be made to lead the international community while contributing to the Asian region, where interest in environmental issues is rising remarkably. In light of its importance, responses to global environmental issues need to be boldly reviewed with leadership and cross-ministerial from a broader perspective based on national discussion.

title: IT 기술을 접목한 항공 임베디드 시스템 개발
abstract: 항공분야 산업은 기계/전자/소재/정보통신 등 첨단과학기술이 유기적으로 융합되어 운영되는 대표적인 IT융합산업이다. 특히, 항공기에서 IT기반 기술이 융합되어 적용되는 곳은 조종사의 성공적인 임무수행을 위한 항공기에 탑재된 응용 소프트웨어와 항공전자장비들로 구성된 항공 임베디드 시스템이다. 항공 임베디드 시스템은 항공기의 성능과 직결되고 신규 개발 및 성능 개량 시 필수적으로 개발해야하는 시스템 종속적인 1차 시스템과 시스템 독립적이며 국내외 부품시장에서 구매 가능한 서브시스템인 2차 시스템으로 나눌 수 있다. 최근 기간산업에 IT 활용 비중이 점차 높아짐에 따라 IT가 기간산업의 경쟁력을 좌우하는 핵심 요소로 부상하고 있으나, IT산업은 성장이 점차 둔화되고 있는 실정이다. 지식경제부는 이에 따라 기간산업의 경쟁력을 높이고 IT기반 융합신산업을 창출하기 위해 5대 IT융합 신 산업 창출과제를 발표했다. 5대 과제중의 하나인 국방전력 극대화 사업으로 우리 기술로 개발한 초음속 고등훈련기인 T-50에 탑재되는 임베디드 소프트웨어 및 컴퓨터를 국산화하고 있다. 본 사업으로 비행운용프로그램, 실시간 운영체제, 미들웨어, 임무컴퓨터 및 무장관리컴퓨터 등이 순조롭게 개발될 경우 전량수입에 의존하고 있는 T-50의 1차 시스템을 100% 국산화할 수 있을 것으로 기대되며 수입대체 효과와 유지보수비용 절감으로 약 2조원의 부가가치 창출이 예상된다. 본 논문에서는 현재 개발을 진행하고 있는 항공 임베디드 시스템에 대하여 알아본다.

title: NC 기반 지휘통제 시설을 위한 국방 I3A 프레임워크
abstract: 미래 전장 환경이 플랫폼 중심전(Platform Centric Warfare)에서 네트워크 중심전(Network Centric Warfare)으로 변화하면서 C4I(Command, Control, Communication, Computer & Intelligence : 지휘, 통제, 통신, 컴퓨터 & 정보) 체계를 이용한 지휘·통제 능력이 더욱 요구되고 있다. 국방부는 시시각각 변화하는 미래전에 대비하기 위한 국방 개혁안을 토대로 2010년 “군사시설 종합 발전계획(Master Plan)”을 수립하였다. 이것은 다양한 안보환경 변화에 따른 대비 소요를 반영하고 합동성 및 3군(육·해·공군) 균형발전을 고려한 군사력 구조조정 및 군 자산관리를 위해 전국에 산재한 소규모 군사시설을 대대 단위로 통·폐합하기 위한 계획이었다. 이를 추진하기 위해서는 대규모 부대이전에 따른 적용 가능한 새로운 시설 및 정보통신 기반 설비의 기준과 지침서 등의 제·개정이 필요하다. 미 국방부의 경우 1990년 부터 각 군(육, 해, 공군)의 국방·군사 시설공사 시 공통적으로 적용이 가능한 시설 기준 통합을 추진하면서 50% 수준의 통합된 시설기준서(UFC : Unified Facilities Criteria)와 통합시설지침 시방서(UFGS : Unified Facilities Guide Specification)를 매년 분기별 갱신하여왔다. 특히, 정보통신기술의 융합은 GCMP(GIG Convergence Master Plan-범세계 격자망 융합 마스터플랜)을 만들어 IP 기반의 데이터, 정보보증, 네트워크 중심전 서비스와 클라우드 컴퓨팅기반의 플랫폼 서비스 융합을 추진하고 있다. 그러나 국방부의 경우 현재의 기준으로 네트워크 중심전 서비스와 미래 클라우드 컴퓨팅기반 서비스의 융합은 물론 지휘·통제 시설과 정보기술 기반의 합리적인 소요 산정도 어려운 현실이다. 따라서 국방부도 시설 통폐합에 따른 C2(Command & Control : 지휘·통제) 시설의 기반 소요 산정과 미래 건설-IT(Information Technology : 정보기술) 융합 기술의 활성화를 위해서는 네트워크 중심전 수행에 알맞은 설계 기준 및 지침의 수립, 그리고 정책적인 노력이 필요하다. 즉, 국방 IT와 시설의 융합은 성공적인 임무수행을 보장할 수 있는 것이다. 본 연구의 목적은 국방·군사 시설기준의 부재로 인한 비합리적인 시설규모와 통신 기반구조 소요의 산출을 억제하고 합리적인 소요 기준선을 제공하기 위해 NC(Network Centric) 기반의 지휘·통제 (C2 : Command & Control) 시설을 위한 국방 I3A(Installation Information Infrastructure Architecture : 정보설비 기반구조) 프레임워크(Framework)를 개발하기 위함이다. 그러나 현용 국방·군사 시설기준을 적용하여 “군사시설 종합 발전계획”을 추진하기 위해서는 시설 기준의 부재 및 비합리적인 시설규모 산정 사례 발생으로 제·개정의 필요성이 대두 되었다. 왜냐하면 대규모 부대이전의 체계적인 사업관리를 위한 기준 및 정보체계에 기반한 시설업무체계의 변화에 적용 가능한 새로운 체계의 기준과 지침서 등이 요구되었기 때문이다. 따라서 본 논문에서는 이러한 문제점을 해결하기 위한 국방 I3A 프레임워크를 제안한다. 본 연구의 범위는 미 국방부의 통신 기반 기준서인 I3A와 미 국방 정보기술 정책서인 통합요구능력서(UCR : Unified Capabilities Requirements)를 분석하고 한·미 국방·군사시설 기준을 비교하는 것이다. 이를 위한 연구방법으로는 첫째, 한·미 국방·군사 시설의 설계 기준에 대한 관련 참조문서를 분석하여보고 둘째, 기존 EA(Enterprise Architecture) 현황을 분석하고 비교하며 국방 I3A 프레임워크의 개발을 위한 구성 요소를 정의한다. 관련 연구결과에 따른 한국 국방·군사시설 구축에 있어 C4I 및 통신기반 설계의 기준선을 제시할 수 있는 효율적이고 공학적인 국방 I3A 프레임워크 개발을 제안한다. 셋째, 적용사례와 비교를 통해 검증하여 본다. 논문의 구성은 크게 제1장 서론에서 연구의 배경, 목적, 범위 및 방법을 기술한다. 제2장 관련연구에서는 미 군사 C2 시설 및 정보기술 기반 통합 서비스 기준과 EA 프레임워크를 현황과 경향을 분석하여 시사점과 새로운 프레임워크 개발의 필요성을 기술한다. 제3장 국방 I3A 프레임워크 개발에서는 프레임워크의 영역과 구성요소를 정의하고 각 모델의 셀(Cell) 속성을 개발한다. 속성 중에서 프레임워크를 평가할 속성을 선별하여본다. 제4장 개발된 국방 I3A 프레임워크에 한·미 국방군사 시설 기준을 적용하고 비교 분석하여본다. 개발한 프레임워크의 효과성을 다른 EA 프레임워크와 비교 검증하고 제5장 결론을 기술한다. 국방 I3A 프레임워크 개발을 통한 기대 효과는 첫째, 표준을 준수하는 통합 시설 및 기지통신기반구조는 각 체계를 지원하는 공통의 프레임워크와 운용환경 제공, 둘째, 향후 확장에 적용될 표준 설비 기반의 확보와 상호운용성 증진을 통한 합동성 강화와 국방 UCR(통합능력 요구서) 개발의 도출이 가능하고 셋째, 물리적 공격 등 어떤 조건하에서도 정보유통을 보장할 수 있는 생존성과 네트워크 중심전(NCW : Net Centric Warfare) 수행 능력을 높이는 시설과 정보기반 기술의 융합성을 제공하며 넷째, 유지보수와 성능개선이 용이하고 개발 비용의 중복을 피하며 예산 절감의 기능과 합리적인 소요 판단의 기준선을 제공하는 것이다.
author: 김영동

title: 가상 현실 기술 동향
abstract: 다양한 정보기술과의 융합을 통해 구현되는 가상현실 기술은 사용자의 체험 영역을 확대하고, 물리적 에너지 및 각종 비용 절감 등의 효과로 인해, 기존의 게임, 군사 훈련 등과 같은 제한된 시뮬레이션 분야를 넘어, 제조업, 서비스 산업, 예술분야, 국방 및 의료 등 다양한 분야로 확장될 것으로 기대를 모으고 있다. 특히, 대표적인 IT 글로벌 기업들이 최근 가상현실을 차세대 성장 동력으로 정하고 준비를 하고 있기에, 이전과 달리 대중화 가능성이 높은 편이다. 따라서, 본 고에서는 가상현실을 위한 기기들의 기술동향과 활용 가능성 및 관련 정책 방향에 대해서 소개하고자 한다.
author: 김익재

title: 국방산업시스템(SCADA) 보안감리 점검체계 개선연구
abstract: 1. 제 목    국방산업시스템(SCADA) 보안감리 점검체계 개선 연구  2. 연구의 배경 및 필요성    IP(Internet Protocol:인터넷) 기반기술에 의해 촉발되는 실시간(RTE : Real time Enterprise) 산업시스템은 극적으로 IT(Information Technology) 생산성을 향상시키며 비즈니스 경쟁력을 제공하고 있다. 방송통신 융합분야에서는 인터넷 전화, IPTV 등과 같은 비즈니스를 부각시켜 놓았으며, 아이러니하게도 이라크전에서는 구글(Google) 위성지도가 알카에다(Al Quada)에게 지역정보(Intelligence)를 제공하기도 하였다. 미래 한국군은 IP 기반기술의 경쟁력에 의해, 네트워크를 단위무기체계에 통합하는 ALL IP(인터넷)환경에 기반한 광대역통합망(BcN)과 인터넷 신주소 체계(IPV6)를 기반으로 연결된 개방형 시스템으로 진화해 나갈 것이며, 이에 따른 장점은 격자망의 인프라 구축 .운용 유지비용 절감과 동시적 정보공유와 정보우위의 전투력 운용 효과가 증가할 것이다. SCADA시스템은 중앙 집중 원격제어시스템으로 원격지에 설치되어 있는 시설물들에 대한 상태 정보 데이터를 수집, 수신, 기록, 표시하여, 자동제어, 감시 및 정보처리 기능을 수행한 시스템이다. 본 연구는 한국군 SCADA시스템을 All IP(인터넷)기반으로 연동하였을 경우 고려해야 할 보안감리 점검체계를 연구하고자 하는 것이다. 현재 SCADA시스템은 폐쇄식 환경에서 인트라넷(회사 자체네트워크), 인터넷과 연동되는 개방형 시스템으로 변화해 가고 있다. 미래 한국군은 국가 주요기반시설(전력, 철도, 댐)과 연동된 국내 상황인식과 인적자원관리와 효율적인 장비/시설관리 및 격오지의 레이더 싸이트, 중계소, GOP 등 근무환경 개선 차원의 원격감시제어시스템체계의 진화가 요구된다. 독립망(폐쇄망)에서 개방형 시스템으로 운영되면 ‘03. 1월 미국 오하이오주의 원자력 발전소의 사설 컴퓨터 네트워크에 슬래머웜이 침투, 안전감시 시스템이 5시간 동안 정지, ’03.8월 미국 동부지역의 철도신호시스템이 소빅-F 웜에 감염되어 수 시간동안 운행이 중단되었던 SCADA시스템 피해 사례와 같이 보안 위협요소(악성코드, 해킹)가 SCADA시스템에 침입한다면 국가 및 국방 안보에 심각한 위험이 초래되므로 위험회피, 위험을 예방 할 수 있는 SCADA시스템의 보안감리는 필요하다.  3. 한국군 보안감리의 한계점    국방상호운용성관리규정, 국방전력발전업무규정, 국방아키텍처관리지침 국방정보체계 상호운용성수준(LISI)업무편람, 국방 공통운용환경 구축 및 관리지침, 국방정보체계 사업관리 지시, 정보체계감리규정(육군규정)등 정보시스템 보안감리에 대한 기존점검 및 구체적 적용가능 항목내용은 찾아 볼 수가 없었다. 또한, 국방정보보호훈령 및 군사보안업무훈령은 정보시스템 정보보안에 대한 기본적인 가이드만을 제시하고 있으며, 정보시스템 정보보호 보안에 대한 세부 지침은 없는 실정에 있다.  4. 연구의 중요성 및 범위    실시간 비즈니스로 대표되는 유비쿼터스시대는 책임추적성(Accountability) 유지와 무결성(Integrity) 보장이 주요한 이슈가 될 것이다. 위의 가설에서 체계연동 이후 보안위협 요소인 적의 해커부대의 사이버공작(악성코드, 해킹, 사이버 테러, 내부자 포섭 위협)으로 부터 사전에 보호할 수 있는 SCADA시스템의 통제 및 보안감리를 수행하기 위한 기본적으로 점검해야할 보안감리 지표 및 보안감리 세부 점검 항목을 제시한다.  5. 가설 및 시나리오    한국군의 전장운영개념 목표는 네트워크 중심전(NCW)을 실현하기 위하여 전장관리(C4I체계), 자원관리, 사무자동화, 기반체계를 통합하는 것이다.  한국군은 전쟁의 양상변화로 지휘관의 지휘결심을 위한 국내 주요기반 시설의 정보공유 및 상황인식 필요성이 제기되어, 한국군 전략적 사고의 의지로 국가 주요 시설인 전력, 철도, 도로, 댐 등의 웹 기반 SCADA시스템(원격감시제어 시스템)을 범 정부 아키텍처 프레임워크를 적용하여 전장관리체계인 합참지휘통제체계(KJCCS)에 연동하여 ALL IP체계를 구축하였다.  6. 결  론    위의 가설을 통하여 보안위협으로부터 사전에 보호할 수 있는 보안감리 기본점검항목 지표 총 42개를 제시하였으며, 군내 전산, 통신, 전자, 연구원 및 보안업무 종사자 총 104명의 설문지 응답자 빈도 분석의 중위수, 최빈값을 적용 결론을 도출하여 SCADA시스템 연동 가설의 필요성에 대한 타당성 및 감리지표 타당성을 검증하였다. 또한 기본점검항목 감리지표를 기반으로 시스템 적용 장비별로 구분하여 감리시점별 보안감리 세부 점검 항목의 계획시점 세부감리 8개영역 33개 항목, 분석시점 세부감리 45개영역 53개 항목, 설계 및 구축시점 세부감리 56개영역 266개 항목, 시험시점 세부감리 14개영역 17개 항목 총 세부감리 123개영역 369개 항목을 도출하였다.  7. 기대 효과    본 논문에 제안한 SCADA시스템 보안 기본점검항목 지표 및 세부 감리 항목은 한국군내 정보시스템 개발․구축․운영의 보안감리분야 및 정보시스템 보안감사에 활용가능 할 것이다.
author: 장남국

title: Low-Q, High-Q 응용을 위한 전력 증폭기에 대한 연구
abstract: RF 전력증폭기 (PA, Power Amplifier)는 마이크로파 및 밀리미터파 시스템을 구현하는데 중요한 역학을 하는 필수 구성요소이다. RF 전력증폭기의 응용으로 이동통신, 레이더, 국방, 무선전력전송 등 광범위하게 활용되고 있다. 다양한 분야에 적용하기 위한 RF 전력증폭기의 기술적 성능은 동작, 기술, 설계 조건에 크게 좌우한다. RF 전력증폭기는 동작 특성상 큰 전류를 소모하기 때문에 많은 열을 방출하게 된다. 이러한 발열은 RF 전력증폭기의 수명과 신뢰성을 떨어뜨리고 안정도를 저해하는 요인이다. 그러므로 무선 시스템에서 RF 전력증폭기의 고효율성은 중요한 설계고려사항이다. 전력증폭기의 효율이 증가하게 되면 추가적인 냉각시스템이 필요하지 않기 때문에 비용을 절감시킬 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 디바이스의 수명을 증가시켜준다. 이러한 고효율 설계를 요구하는 대표적인 무선 시스템 응용 중 하나는 무선전력전송 시스템이다. 최근 IT 기술과 에너지기술을 융합한 무선전력전송 기술의 등장에 따라 일상 생활에서 사용되는 전선으로부터 자유로움을 주고 있다. 무선전력전송 시스템의 효율은 일반적으로 송신단의 전력증폭기 효율과 송신 코일과 수신 코일 사이의 전송 효율과 수신단의 전력수신효율의 곱으로 정해진다. 전력증폭기는 동작 바이어스 영역에 따라 크게 선형증폭기 구조와 스위치 모드로 동작하는 전력증폭기로 구분한다. 성현 증폭기의 경우 전력 소자를 포화영역에서 동작시켜 입력 신호와 출력 신호의 왜곡을 최소화하여 신호를 증폭시켜 이론적으로 최대 효율이 78.5 %를 넘을 수 없다. 이러한 이유로 선형 증폭기 작동 방식은 더 높은 효율을 요구하는 무선전력전송 전력증폭기 구조로 적합하지 않다. 따라서 효율을 증가시키기 위한 방법으로 스위치 모드로 동작하는 전력증폭기가 많이 사용되고 있다. 스위치 모드 구조는 이론적으로 100 %의 효율을 얻을 수 있다. 스위치 모드는 결국 해당 동작 주파수에서 이루어지는 스위칭 동작에 의해 발생하는 고조파 신호를 적절하게 차단하는 것이 핵심이다. E급 전력증폭기는 간단한 구조로 구현이 가능함과 동시에 효과적으로 고조파를 억압하기 때문에 무선전력전송 전력증폭기에 많이 활용되고 있다. 또한, 무선전력전송이 이루어지는 주파수는 국제표준기관에서 지정한 6.78 MHz이다. 해당 주파수에서는 그림 1-1과 같이 실리콘 LMOS(Laterally Diffused Metal Oxide Semiconductor) 소자의 고출력 디바이스를 사용하여 설계가 이루어진다. LDMOS 소자는 1.5 GHz 미만의 주파수 대역에서 효율 개선, 와트 당 비교 성능 등의 경쟁력 있는 성능을 보여준다. Chapter 2에서는 LDMOS 소자를 사용하여 6.78 MHz 120 W급 전력증폭기에 대해서 살펴본다.
author: 최의규

title: 버섯 재배를 위한 IoT기반 스마트 제어 운영 시스템
abstract: IT(Information Technology)융합 기술은 다양한 정보(Sensing, Networking, Computing, Actuation 등) 기술 및 서비스에 임베디드(Embedded)되어 각 영역에 거대한 영향을 미치고 있다. 이로 인해 사물인터넷(IoT, Internet of Things), 정보통신기술(ICT, Information Communication Technology), 빅데이터(Big Data)등 새로운 개념이 나타나고, 더욱 빠르게 발전하고 있다. 특히 IoT는 농업, 의료, 국방 등 다양한 분야에서 활용되며, 새로운 가치를 창출하고 있다. &#xD; 오늘날 지구 환경의 악화로 이용 가능한 토지자원이 감소하고 기후변화가 자주 발생하고 있다. 또한 농가 인구의 감소와 고령화로 인해 노동력이 부족하며, 원부자재비 등의 생산비 증가와 농업 시장 개방 가속화로 농업활동에 많은 어려움이 있어 농업의 발전과 진화가 필요한 실정이다. 이러한 문제와 더불어 세계 인구가 증가하고 있으며, 소비자는 농작물에 대해 높은 품질과 안정성을 요구하고 있다. 이에 따라 세계 각국은 IoT융합기술을 연구하고 개발하여 최적의 농작물 생육환경을 스마트하게 유지할 수 있도록 생산 시설을 자동화 시켜 자원이용률을 제고하고, 노동력을 줄이는 동시에 농작물의 품질과 생산성은 향상시키는 기술을 개발하고 있다. &#xD; 본 논문에서는 웰빙시대를 맞이하여 건강식품으로서 주목받고 있으며, 기술개발을 통해 인공재배가 크게 확대되고 있는 버섯을 대상으로 연구하였다. 버섯은 인공재배 시 버섯 생육상태에 필요한 환경요소(온도, 습도, CO2 등)의 변화에 따라 큰 영향을 받는다. 따라서 버섯의 효율적 재배를 위해서는 실시간으로 환경요소 데이터 값을 측정하고 자동으로 제어하는 장치가 중요한 문제가 되었다. 본 논문에서는 버섯 인공재배 시 노동력을 감소시키고 최적의 생육환경을 유지하여 버섯의 품질을 향상시키는 IoT기반의 스마트 제어 운영 시스템을 구축하였다. &#xD; 시스템을 정확하게 구축하고 현실성을 반영하기 위해서 버섯의 생육상태에 대하여 공인인증을 통해 비교 분석한 실험 자료를 제시하였다. 이러한 비교 분석 자료를 기반으로 한 판단 알고리즘을 적용하여 최적의 생육환경을 제시하였으며, 사용자의 편의성을 위해 버섯 생육환경의 실시간 모니터링을 제공하여 신뢰성을 향상시킬 수 있었다. 본 시스템은 센서를 통해 실시간으로 측정된 환경 데이터 값을 표식장치 및 컴퓨터 모니터에 표식하여 사용자가 쉽게 버섯 생육환경을 파악하고 기록할 수 있는 특징이 있다. 또한, 자동제어 기능은 버섯 생육환경 데이터 값이 정상범위에서 벗어나면 온도, 습도, CO2의 최적상태 유지 알고리즘에 따라 버섯 농장에 있는 장치(에어컨, 환풍기 등)를 구동할 수 있도록 하였다. 또한 최적의 생육환경 제어를 적용하기 위해 공인기관인 한국정보통신기술협회(TTA, Telecommunications Technology Association)에서 본 시스템의 온·습도 장치의 정확성을 시험하여 오류율과 정확성을 확인하였다. 본 시스템을 통해 버섯 재배 시 품질 향상과 비용절감 효과를 기대할 수 있다. &#xD; 향후에 본 시스템은 서버 연동 네트워크와 연결하여 모바일 환경에서 버섯 등 농작물 재배환경의 효율적인 관리를 수행할 수 있도록 확장할 계획이다. 그리고 인터넷 브라우저와 농장에 설치된 원격카메라를 연동시켜 농작물의 생육상태 및 생산시설의 환경상태를 확인할 수 있도록 하려고 한다. 또한 본 시스템을 바탕으로 ICT를 활용한 농작물 구매 고객접근 시스템을 모색할 수 있으며, 고객정보 빅데이터를 활용하여 마케팅효과를 기대할 수 있다.
author: 쉬천린

title: 사이버위협 정보공유 시스템 확산에 영향을 미치는 핵심요인에 관한 연구
abstract: 최근 국방부의 업무망 해킹으로 인한 군사비밀 유출, 미국 대통령 선거에 러시아 개입 논란, 방글라데시 중앙은행 금전 탈취 등 고도의 해킹기술이 동원되는 사이버위협은 이제 시간과 공간을 초월함은 물론 국내와 해외를 가리지 않고 동시다발적으로 발생하고 있다.&#xD; 앞으로 정보통신기술의 환경이 획기적으로 개선되면서 점차 사이버위협은 더욱 지능적으로 고도화될 것이기 때문에 해킹을 미연에 방지하는 보안대책을 수립하는 한편 사고 발생 시에도 체계적이고 신속한 대응조치를 취하기 위해서는 관계기관 간의 정보공유가 그 무엇보다도 중요할 것이며 그 체계 구축이 향후 국가안보 수호와 국익 창출을 위한 핵심적인 대응방안의 한 요소로 대두될 것이다. &#xD; 이에 본 논문에서는 사이버위협 정보공유 시스템의 구축·운영에 관한 사례와 정책·제도 동향 등 국내외 체계와 실태를 연구하고 분석하여 각급기관의 실정에 맞는 사이버위협 정보공유 시스템을 도입하고 확산하는데 있어 영향을 미치는 요인에 대한 실증적 연구를 수행하여 국가·공공기관은 물론 민간기관 등 국가 전반의 사이버안보 수준을 향상시키는데 대안을 제시하고자 한다.&#xD; 기술-조직-환경 프레임워크(TOE Framework)와 통합기술수용이론(UTAUT)을 융합하여 시스템의 도입과 확산에 영향을 미치는 요인을 독립변수로 설정하고 행위의도(도입의도) 및 사용행동(실제도입)에 미치는 영향을 분석하는 연구모형을 설정하였으며, TOE 변수로는 비용, 보안, 경영층 지원, 경쟁자 압력, 규정 등 5개로 설정하였고, UTAUT 요인으로는 성과기대, 노력기대, 사회적 영향, 촉진조건 등 4개로 설정하였으며, 또한 변수 간 조절효과를 검증하기 위해 기관의 유형(공공기관/민간기관), 조직의 규모(300명 미만/이상), 근무기간(10년 미만/이상), 종사 여부(종사자/비종사자) 등 4개를 조절변수로 설정하였다. &#xD; 본 연구를 위한 자료 수집을 위해 국가&#x2024;공공기관 및 보안관련 IT 기업 등을 대상으로 설문조사를 실시하였는데, 448부의 설문지를 회수하여 그 중 350부를 유효 설문으로 채택하여 검증을 위한 자료로 활용하였으며, SPSS 18과 AMOS 18을 이용하여 설정된 연구모형을 검증하여 총16개(조절효과 제외)의 가설 중 12개가 채택되었다. &#xD; 연구가설을 검증한 결과, 첫째, TOE 변수인 비용, 보안, 경영층 지원, 경쟁자 압력, 규정 등 5개 요인 모두가 행위의도에 영향을 미치고, 경영층 지원과 경쟁자 압력은 사용행동에도 영향을 미치나, 비용, 보안, 규정 요인은 사용행동에 영향을 미치지 못하는 것으로 나타났다. &#xD; 둘째, UTAUT 변수 4개 중 성과기대, 사회적 영향, 촉진조건 요인은 행위의도에 영향을 미치나, 노력기대는 행위의도에 영향을 미치지 못하며, 촉진조건은 사용행동에도 영향을 미치는 것으로 나타났다. &#xD; 셋째, 독립변수와 매개&#x2024;종속변수간의 조절효과를 분석한 결과, 기관의 유형, 조직의 규모, 근무기간, 종사 여부 등 4가지 모두가 그 영향의 정도는 다르지만 일정부분의 조절효과를 나타내는 것으로 분석되었다. &#xD; 넷째, 사이버위협 정보공유 시스템을 도입&#x2024;확산하는데 있어 요인별로 영향을 미치는 정도(순위)를 분석해보면, UTAUT 요인 중에서는 촉진조건 요인이 제일 큰 영향요인으로 나타났으며, TOE 요인 중에서는 경쟁자 압력 요인이 제일 큰 영향요인으로 나타났다. &#xD; 본 논문의 연구는 사이버위협 정보공유 시스템의 도입과 확산을 위한 통합적인 연구모형을 설정하고 검증함으로써 기존의 연구보다는 진일보하여 학술적인 가치가 있을 것이며, 또한 사이버위협 정보공유 활성화 관련 논의가 한창인 시점에 연구가 진행되어 바로 사이버안보 정책에 반영할 수 있을 것으로 보여 실용적인 가치도 충분할 것으로 기대된다. 다만, 본 논문이 사이버위협 정보공유 시스템의 도입과 확산을 중심으로 연구를 진행하였으므로 향후에는 시스템의 사용에 따른 사이버위협 예방 실적과 사고의 대응 과정에서 실질적인 성과가 창출되고 있는지를 측정할 수 있는 심층적인 연구가 필요하다. &#xD; &#xD; &#xD;
author: 윤오준

title: 국방 IT 거버넌스 개선에 관한 연구
abstract: 현대의 정보화 사회에서는 정보기술이 기업과 공공기관에 도입되면서 정보기술 전반을 관리해야 한다는 필요성이 대두되었고, 비즈니스 목표와 IT의 연계 필요성이 증대되고 함께 IT투자의 중복을 방지하고 ROI를 추구하는 조직들이 늘어났다. 이에 여러 선진 기업들이 IT 거버넌스라는 개념을 제창하였다. IT 거버넌스는 기업의 비즈니스와 IT에 영향을 미치는 구조적 결정인자들의 구조 및 동적양상을 나타내며, 비즈니스와 IT 관련 사내외 위원회 및 부서, 그리고 그들의 활동범위 및 연관관계를 나타내는 프레임워크, 조직도 및 프로세스 구성으로 표현이 된다. 이러한 외부적인 요인과 맞물려 현재 우리 군의 국방 비전과 목표를 달성하기 위한 국방 IT 거버넌스의 재확립은 필수적인 사항이 되었다. 본 논문에서는 국방 IT 거버넌스의 프레임워크를 구축하기 위한 핵심 추진전략에 대해서 기술하였다. 이러한 주장에 뒷받침하기 위해서 IT 거버넌스의 전반적인 내용을 기술하고 국내 외와 해외의 군 사례를 분석하여 보고 국방 IT 거버넌스의 프레임워크 구축을 위한 핵심 추진전략을 연구하였다.
author: 양호경;박현규;차현종;조용건;

title: 국방 IT 거버넌스 및 원칙 수립에 관한 연구
abstract: 많은 조직들이 급변하는 환경에 능동적으로 대처하기 위하여 IT를 활용하여 전략을 수립하고 있다. 사업적 목표와 IT 구축의 목표를 일치 시키고 IT 자산을 효율적으로 관리하며, 투자 투명성을 확보하기 위하여 IT 거버넌스를 도입한다. 특히 국제 정세가 빠르게 변화함에 따라 국방 정보의 거버넌스 역시 중요시 되었다. 하지만 국방 IT 거버넌스를 체계적으로 규명한 연구는 미흡하다. 본 연구에서는 선행 연구들로부터 도출한 시사점들과 대한민국 국방 상황의 고유 성격에 근거하여 국방 IT 거버넌스를 정의하였다. 또한 국방정보 거버넌스의 프레임워크를 제안하였고, 의사결정 체계를 고안하였으며, 이를 토대로 원칙을 수립하였다. 본 연구의 결과는 장기적 관점에서 국방 정보에 유용한 지침이 될 것으로 기대된다.
author: 조현;곽기호;김성희;김병천;

title: 국방 IT 거버넌스 프레임워크 구축을 위한 핵심 추진전략 연구
abstract: 1990년대 중반 이후 인터넷이나 휴대전화와 같은 정보기술의 보급에 따라, 정보가 사회 및 경제의 중심이 되는 정보화 사회로 변화하였다. 기업과 공공기관에 IT(정보기술)이 도입되면서 경영목표와 IT의 연계 필요성이 증대되었다. 또한 IT 전반에 대한 관리의 필요성이 대두되었다. 더불어 IT 투자의 중복을 방지하는 등의 ROI( Return On Investment : 투자수익)을 추구하는 조직이 늘어났다. 결과적으로 IT 거버넌스에 대해 학계와 산업계에서 다양한 정의와 설명들이 제시되고 있으며, 이미 선진기업에서는 IT 거버넌스라는 개념을 경영에 적용하고 있다. IT 거버넌스는 기업의 비즈니스와 IT에 영향을 미치는 구조적 결정인자들의 구조 및 동적양상을 나타내며, 비즈니스와 IT 관련 사내외 위원회 및 부서, 그리고 그들의 활동범위 및 연관관계를 나타내는 프레임워크, 조직도 및 프로세스 구성으로 표현이 된다. 이러한 외부적인 요인과 맞물려 현재 우리 군의 국방 비전과 목표를 달성하기 위한 국방 IT 거버넌스의 재확립은 필수적인 사항이 되었다. 본 논문에서는 국방 IT 거버넌스의 프레임워크를 구축하기 위한 핵심 추진전략에 대해서 기술하였다. 이러한 주장에 뒷받침하기 위해서 IT 거버넌스의 전반적인 내용을 기술하고 국내&#8729;외와 해외의 군 사례를 분석하여 보고 국방 IT 거버넌스의 프레임워크 구축을 위한 핵심 추진전략을 연구하였다.
author: 양호경

title: 국방·IT 융합: 군사용 로봇을 중심으로
abstract: 군사용 로봇은 국방 IT 융합의 대표적인 적용 사례로 인간을 대신하거나 보조하며, 군사작전을 수행하는 지능형 로봇이다. 특히 테러와의 전쟁 속에 비정규전으로 많은 희생자들이 발생하면서 전쟁에 대한 비난여론이 확산되자 사람 대신 전쟁을 치루는 로봇은 당당한 주역으로 부상하고 있다. 군대는 로봇에 점점 의존하고 있고, 육상.해상.공중을 가리지 않고 로봇의 활용도는 커지고 있으며, 로봇을 도입하는 군대가 전투력에서 우위를 점하고 있다. 현재 군사용 로봇은 미국, 유럽, 러시아, 중국, 이스라엘, 한국 등을 중심으로 활발히 개발되고 있다.
